description: For bijections \(e : \mathbb N \to A\) and \(f : \mathbb N \to B\), the map \(n \mapsto (e(\delta(n).1), f(\delta(n).2))\) is a bijective enumeration of \(A \times B\), where \(\delta\) is the diagonal enumeration.
signature:
